title: Inventory Transaction Touchpoint

children:
Inventory transaction data, such as positive/negative adjustments and 
 transfers, can be uploaded to your ERP via the system interface. This 
 ensures that the ERP keeps its inventory balances aligned with the system's 
 balances.

To see actual examples of 
 the inventory transaction touchpoint, see the following topics:

The interface can upload transaction history records 
 that identify inventory changes at a particular location (or locations). 
 Short picks are always included in inventory transaction uploads. All 
 other adjustments can be interfaced if the Include in Interface Upload 
 Checkbox is selected on its Adjustment Type Window.

The upload will include records for all locations 
 that were touched by an adjustment, since the last time that the inventory 
 interface was run. If multiple transactions were committed at one location, 
 the system will generate one record per transaction. If a transfer occurs, 
 one transaction record is generated per location involved. The record 
 cannot have been interfaced previously.

content_text:
Inventory Transaction Touchpoint
        Inventory transaction data, such as positive/negative adjustments and 
 transfers, can be uploaded to your ERP via the system interface. This 
 ensures that the ERP keeps its inventory balances aligned with the system's 
 balances.
         
         
        To see actual examples of 
 the inventory transaction touchpoint, see the following topics:
        
            - Delimited Interface Tutorial
            - Fixed Length Interface Tutorial
            - Direct Interface Tutorial
            - XML Interface Tutorial
        
         
        General Guidelines...
        
            The interface can upload transaction history records 
 that identify inventory changes at a particular location (or locations). 
 Short picks are always included in inventory transaction uploads. All 
 other adjustments can be interfaced if the Include in Interface Upload 
 Checkbox is selected on its Adjustment Type Window. 
            The upload will include records for all locations 
 that were touched by an adjustment, since the last time that the inventory 
 interface was run. If multiple transactions were committed at one location, 
 the system will generate one record per transaction. If a transfer occurs, 
 one transaction record is generated per location involved. The record 
 cannot have been interfaced previously.
        
         
         
        Catch Weight Fields (XML Upload Only)
         
        
            CatchWeight and CatchWeightUM are available only when the upload output method is XML.
        
         
        Rejection Causes / Validations / Notes...
        
            The SCALE interface process does not support using 
 a comma as a "seperator" for numeric values. These values will 
 need to be interfaced into the system using decimals as seperators (4.95, not         4,95). 
 The system can, however, display these values with a comma seperator on 
 SCALE windows, but in the database they must be in a decimal format.
        
         
         
        Selection of Transaction History Records for the Upload Interface...
        Depending on what transaction type the transaction history record has, the upload interface handles it differently.  The following sections define how the system determines whether to upload the records based on transaction type.
         
        A) Excluded Transactions
        The following transaction history records are excluded from the inventory transaction upload, regardless of whether the history transaction type configuration has the "Include in Interface Upload" setting set to Yes.  The reason is that these transactions get uploaded in other interfaces, such as the shipment upload, or they do not actually affect on hand inventory.
         
        These transaction types are excluded from the upload in all cases:
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    
                        ID
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Description
                        
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        100
                         
                    
                    
                        Over pick adjustment
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        150
                         
                    
                    
                        Quantity adjustment
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        240
                         
                    
                    
                        Short pick adjustment
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        250
                         
                    
                    
                        Under pick adjustment
                         
                    
                
            
        
         
        B) Inventory Management Transactions
        These transactions are triggered by the inventory management process.  In this case, the corresponding adjustment type must be configured to be included in the interface upload.
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    
                        ID
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Description
                        
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        40
                         
                    
                    
                        Inventory adjustment
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        50
                         
                    
                    
                        Inventory status change
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        60
                         
                    
                    
                        Inventory transfer
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        350
                         
                    
                    
                        Company transfer
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        360
                         
                    
                    
                        Warehouse transfer
                         
                    
                
            
        
         
        For these transaction types, the inventory transaction upload selects records from transaction history.  It selects records matching the following criteria:
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    
                        Transaction History Field
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Value For Selection
                        
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Upload Interface Batch
                         
                    
                    
                        NULL
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Transaction Type
                         
                    
                    
                        Associated Adjustment Type configuration must have the "Include in Interface Upload" setting set to Yes.
                         
                    
                
            
        
         
        Note that in this case the system does NOT check that the transaction type is set to be included in the interface upload.
         
         
        C) Other Transactions
        For anything not included in the transaction types listed in sections A and B above, the system uploads the records if their transaction type is set to be included in the interface upload.
         
        The inventory transaction upload selects records from transaction history.  It selects records matching the following criteria:
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    
                        Transaction History Field
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Value For Selection
                        
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Upload Interface Batch
                         
                    
                    
                        NULL
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Transaction Type
                         
                    
                    
                        Associated History Transaction Types configuration must have the "Include in Interface Upload" setting set to Yes.
